title: 4_1_Full_Court_Pressure

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
Do you think you know who sabotaged Autumn's art?
How do you feel about playing as Ben?
options: I love playing as him! More please!
He's fun, but I'm getting tired of him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's... That exactly what you to say to someone when it `is` their fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... That exactly what you to say to someone when it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] their fault.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could have run faster, pushed you guys harder, passed even fancier!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's really nothing I can say to make you think otherwise is there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm afraid that ship has sailed, Benjamin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone's?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. We all practice together, Erik. It's as much your responsibility to get us prepared for games as it is everyone else's.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha! When you think about it like that, we're all stars of the team!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Pigs in a blanket! That cheers me up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So then, you're going to be ready for practice?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am now!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Cool. I'll see you then.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Benjamin! You really pulled me out of a dark place!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Something tells me you don't really have any dark places, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just my armpits!
Ben spends the rest of the day tracking down the other basketball players...
In class...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Psst! Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What is it, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're a small team... We need everyone at practice today and focused!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sure, I'll be there and ready. For the team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks.
In the cafeteria...
Ben sits across from Andy, who doesn't say anything...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When you come to practice today, I don't want you to make any jokes about your eye.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? You don't like them?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I love them. I love it when we get to goof around. But for this one practice, we need to be tough-as-nails serious.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You got it, Boss. One last one before I quit for the day?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, get it out now.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Why did I hit my head on the bottom of the pool?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I have no `depth perception.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have no [color=#e23b3b][i]depth perception.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: All right. I'm serious now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good. See you at practice then.
In the library...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey there, Benjamin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Erik... I'm surprised you're so chipper!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you mean, buddy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, all the other guys are feeling pretty down after our loss to Willow Glen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I don't know if I've ever felt this depressed in my whole life!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you seem so cheerful...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On the outside, maybe. But on the inside, I feel like I'm falling into a chasm of depression!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't help but feel like the loss was all my fault!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your fault? But Erik, you spent most of the game on the bench!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know, but there are a lot of things I do for the team to prepare for games.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I'm not playing my best against you guys in practice, you won't be ready for the guys you play against in the games!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I assure you, we were as ready as we could have been.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige? I thought for sure if you were to pick one, it'd be $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not about me, it's about who `you` love. And even though it's love-hate with Paige, it's still `love.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not about me, it's about who [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] love. And even though it's love-hate with Paige, it's still [color=#e23b3b][i]love.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Even thinking about making a choice seems... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well you're going to have to because the longer you wait, the more likely you're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But avoiding hurting one of them is no reason to rush into a choice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, don't listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't! Because it doesn't seem like good advice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I give up then! See you at practice!
Ben stands up and marches off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I figured you'd pick $ZOE. You two are pretty good friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, there are times to pick a side and there are times not to...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But when it comes to Paige vs. $ZOE, I'm always going to pick $ZOE. Paige is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? Paige is what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'll just say that you're right when you say that $ZOE is really nice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... Even thinking about making a choice seems... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well you're going to have to because the longer you wait, the more likely you're going to hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But avoiding hurting one of them is no reason to rush into a choice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, don't listen to me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't! Because it doesn't seem like good advice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I give up then! See you at practice!
Ben stands up and marches off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A distraction? You're not going to tell me to take up a hobby, are you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No. It's pretty simple, actually...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't know what you want right now, and you shouldn't force it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But it's all I can think about...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's where a distraction comes in. You need something to keep you from going crazy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And as self-serving as this seems...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you wanted something to take your mind off the girls, basketball's probably your best bet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that makes sense...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Another case solved by Ben Kale, detective, girl division.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh. Better title.
Ben stands and heads off to class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you at practice?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... I'll see you there!
After a short walk back, Ben finds Owen sitting by himself on the steps to the side of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, I know you're down. I know it seems like we don't have much hope... But we just have to re-focus!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `I'm` focused, and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to prove to you just how focused I am!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] focused, and I'm willing to do whatever it takes to prove to you just how focused I am!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever challenge you've got, I'll accept it! Even if it means trying to score a touchdown on you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What on earth are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, aren't you feeling down?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because of the basketball game?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? No. I mean... I `am` sad about the game, but that's not what's bothering me now.
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No. I mean... I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] sad about the game, but that's not what's bothering me now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess the same tactics that work with Spencer aren't going to work with Owen!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... What `is` bothering you?
nodes.text_bbcode: So... What [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] bothering you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To put it bluntly... Girls.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well say no more!
Ben cracks his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ben Kale, girl detective, at your service!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You realize that 'girl detective' could mean that you are a girl who is a detective, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The name's in beta, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now... Tell me your troubles!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's Paige...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A troublesome girl if ever there was one.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...And $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The plot thickens.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: With Paige, it's like every time I'm around her, I'm annoyed. She antagonizes me to no end.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's like I want to kiss her and kill her all at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Classic love-hate relationship.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: On the other hand, $ZOE's like the nicest person who's ever existed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Understatement. I heard she's even helping Autumn with that Art Showcase thing...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... What does the girl who is a detective think?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Girl detective!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And there's no doubt about it. You are confused, bro.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What would you do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

nodes.prompt: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: If I were in your shoes, I'd...

nodes.text: Ben tries to leap over Spencer!
But Spencer grabs him out of the air and slams him into the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You really thought you could jump over `me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You really thought you could jump over [color=#e23b3b][i]me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see the ridiculousness of that idea `now...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I see the ridiculousness of that idea [color=#e23b3b][i]now...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You couldn't get by me... That means get off my field. I've got football to prepare for.
Ben slowly get up and trudges his way back to the school...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See you at practice...
Ben stops, his eyes going wide!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dude, what happened to your shoes?!
Spencer stops and looks at them!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My shoes?! What's wrong with them? Did--
Ben breaks away toward the end zone!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You tricked me!
Spencer races after him, dives, and leaps into the air for the tackle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So fast!
Ben leaps forward for the end zone just as Spencer grabs onto his leg!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoop!
Ben falls to the ground, but has just enough energy to stretch the ball out over the goal line!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I should have known you'd pull a dirty trick like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was the only way!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, well, a deal's a deal. I'll be at practice, and I'll be ready.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good.
Ben dusts himself off and immediately heads back toward the school.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're not the only guy on the team, remember?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear, Kale!
Ben hesitates... And Spencer slams right into him, knocking him to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Basketball isn't over, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Seems pretty over to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We only lost by two points! We can beat Wilson High.
Spencer slams into the dummy!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah? After we lost to Willow Glen, what did we care about most? A dumb dance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You were there with us!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not happy about my behavior either.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you're upset because we didn't seem to care?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm not upset! I'm just being real.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've been on a championship team! Do you know what happens when the football team loses a game?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We spend time together. We practice. We get focused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're having basketball practice today!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But are we together? Are we focused? Where's Owen? Where's Andy? Where's Jacob? Where's Nerd?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Erik?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. We're not together, man! Practice is going to suck, and we're going to lose our game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, what? You're just skipping ahead to football?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: At least I'm getting a head start...
Ben picks up a football from a nearby bin. As Spencer gets into position, Ben stands between him and the dummy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! If you're going to be out here, then I'm going to be out here with you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Move!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Fine! You want to play football? Let's play football!
Spencer walks over to the end zone and stands on the goal line.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on! Bring it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Get by me! Score a touchdown!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And if I do?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You won't! But if you do, then I won't give up on basketball.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... I need to score a touchdown... To save basketball?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just shut up and try to get by me so I can tackle you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer's the star linebacker... There's no way I can get by him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unless...
Ben starts running toward Spencer, who gets down in a fearsome defensive stance.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr!
As Ben nears him, Spencer surges forward!
Just as Spencer's about to tackle Ben, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pfft! Get your head out of your butt, Kale.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've still got one game left.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Which we're going to lose. Stick a fork in us. We're done.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: How? How will that happen?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We'll win this game, and then we'll play Willow Glen in Sectionals, and we'll get our revenge!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I like the idea, but you're dreaming.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't you think you've done enough to impress my dad, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not at all. We lost one game, and he started doubting whether I can operate a stopwatch!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Winning isn't everything.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know that. But your dad's different. How the team does ties directly into what he thinks of me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And if I reminded you that I don't care what he thinks of you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'd remind you that when he thought I was a winner, I ate a Thanksgiving meal at your house, `and` I got the chance to spend more time with you at practice.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd remind you that when he thought I was a winner, I ate a Thanksgiving meal at your house, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] I got the chance to spend more time with you at practice.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I did like that this morning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did too. And until we've got a better idea, the best way for me to be in his good graces is to win.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ugh. It's so stupid.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Them's the breaks, kid. Now I've gotta go!
Ben gives her a quick kiss and hurries off!
A few minutes later, Ben finds Spencer on the football field, lining up in front of a tackling dummy.
Spencer gets down low, growls, and explodes forward! His body slams into the dummy with a loud `whomp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Spencer gets down low, growls, and explodes forward! His body slams into the dummy with a loud [b]whomp![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Hey, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing out here, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was going to ask you the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's it look like?
Spencer explodes forward again, knocking the dummy backwards.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It looks like you're practicing for football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's why you get straight A's.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could stop for a moment?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is stupid, Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, I don't get straight A's, so everyone's doing as expected.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I mean, why are you practicing for football? The season's over!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What else do I have to look forward to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can look forward to...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Funky? That doesn't sound like my dad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, as soon as I said it, I knew it wasn't going to fly...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't imagine your dad telling anyone to be funky... Unless they had a soul patch.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! How about you focus on what's important?! Like why you lied to me just now?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I saw how upset you got when I mentioned your dad, and I kinda freaked out.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He told me what you just told me... That I had to focus. Like father, like daughter, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He said that the team gets its energy from me. That if I'm focused, they'll be focused.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's... Actually pretty good advice.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: See? Swimsuit... Unbunched.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sometimes I forget that my dad can be a pretty good teacher.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean, when he's not being a--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll go ahead and stop you there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good call.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Should... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Should, uh, be... Something. Funky, maybe?
Then he stops and turns back, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, Denni?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Colt wasn't doing anything wrong two nights ago. I was just having fun with you.
He leaves.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great. Now I'm actually worried.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What a peculiar guy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Pot. Kettle. Black. Come on! You're the poster girl for peculiar!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Guilty as charged.
You are now playing as Ben.
Ben and Emily enter the school and walk by Autumn and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! Check out the Art Showcase!
Ben grabs a flyer.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You'll never have a more mystical experience!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, okay.
As they walk down the hall, Ben notices a picture of three cheerleaders taped to a locker.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is like the picture the swim team was talking about!
He reads the top caption...
SUPER CRITICAL OF ATHLETES...
Then the bottom caption...
WON'T DO ANYTHING THAT MIGHT BREAK A NAIL.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. That's pretty hypocritical!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You know, that's the second one of those I've seen today!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wonder who's putting them up...
When they reach another wing of the campus, Ben turns away from Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Where are you going? Class is this way.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I forgot to tell you. I've gotta talk to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. I need to talk to all the guys before basketball practice. I'm the leader.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And what brought this idea on?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Something your dad said...
Emily crosses her arms.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what did my dad say now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. It's not worth getting your swimsuit in a bunch over.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll decide that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, he just said that I should...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're a book, all right, but you're more like a collection of sad ballads.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Uh... That's...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow, I've never seen you speechless before.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ahem. I just, uh, had something in my throat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: In case you're wondering how I did that? It's a talent.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I wasn't wondering.
Wes winks at Autumn and walks away...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Bored? You think I'm bored doing what I do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You haven't lived until you've pulled the kind of strings I've pulled.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Like what? Give me one example of something exciting you've done.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, I got one. Last year, I got a school I `didn't go to` to pay me money to test their new security system.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I got one. Last year, I got a school I [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't go to[/i][/color] to pay me money to test their new security system.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Which they installed because of a series of false reports `I` filed about suspicious activity on campus!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which they installed because of a series of false reports [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] filed about suspicious activity on campus!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That all sounds like something you can do from your computer.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I didn't tell you the best part!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: After they installed the security system, I went with a rival to the school to steal some stupid thing I made up.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I had already alerted the police to his presence, telling them that he was the suspicious person, and that I'd be `working undercover.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I had already alerted the police to his presence, telling them that he was the suspicious person, and that I'd be [color=#e23b3b][i]working undercover.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: As soon as the alarm tripped, they nabbed him, and gave me a reward for the tip.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Most of that sounds despicable.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Ah, but you don't have all the facts. You don't know what he'd done to become my rival.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: True... And I guess it does sound pretty exciting.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's okay. Not everyone's as talented as I am.
He winks at Autumn and walks away.
Wes slips in through the front doors.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Denni! How's the Art Showcase promo going?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Should I even bother asking how you knew what we were doing?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No, that would be a total waste of your time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But for just twenty bucks, I'll tell you what Colt was up to two nights ago.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And that's some info you may find worth your while.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll pass. Colt and I have a little thing called `trust` between us.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll pass. Colt and I have a little thing called [color=#3b78e2][i]trust[/i][/color] between us.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Trust. Blindness. Stupidity. It goes by so many names.
Wes notices Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hello.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's no point in me saying this, but Wes, this is--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Autumn, the freshman artist...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You prefer water colors to paints, but your real passion is photography...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Even though it goes against every fiber of your being, you enjoy pop music.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, and you broke your arm a long time ago in a nasty fall down some stairs.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Neat trick. I'm impressed.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's a talent.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: My turn.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `You're` going to read `me?` I'm afraid that can't be done. I'm a book written in a language no one knows.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You're[/i][/color] going to read [color=#e23b3b][i]me?[/i][/color] I'm afraid that can't be done. I'm a book written in a language no one knows.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're Wes. The guy who gets things. Always conniving, always looking for the angle.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No secret.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But no one knows your past, which you will do anything and everything to hide.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Easy enough.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: When I look at you, I see past this facade of confidence. I see a guy who's hiding just how...

nodes.prompt: I see a guy who's hiding just how...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I see a guy who's hiding just how...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Very sloppy. A collection of teeth `is` teeth!
nodes.text_bbcode: Very sloppy. A collection of teeth [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] teeth!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The only possible difference is that a collection might indicate that the teeth are loose, outside of any mouth.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And teeth are always better when they're in your mouth. Conclusion... Best case scenario is you're less wrong!
Andrew rushes past them in a huff.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: He gets like this sometimes. By sometimes I mean everyday.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Life of the artist... Always wear a thick skin!
Kevin and Ashley nod and walk away.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I see you have a flair for metaphor. I always tip my proverbial cap to a fellow bard.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A pleasure.
Andrew takes a flyer, and the nerds walk away.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: A painting is a what?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: An endless nothingness?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sloppy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: A tooth collection?
A moment later, a couple of nerds stumble through the door...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come to the Art Showcase! Have a flyer!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Thanks! I love these kind of events!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: I'll be there!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Pfft! I won't. Why look at a bunch of paintings and photos when you can imagine them with words, the greatest medium of art known to man?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: After all, the word is to painting as a giant flat-screen TV is to a cardboard box.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I disagree. Words are mere teeth. But a painting is a...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, yeah, of course we care about how they look! But that's not art!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sure it is!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All we care about is whether they'll go fast!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Or hug a corner!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Or last for years!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're more concerned about the function than the form?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How presumptuous of me to think you overvalued aesthetics!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Huh?
Denni whispers to Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You've got the right idea, but you're not working on the right level. Allow me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ryan, how would you feel if I colored your motorcycle hot pink?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What?! No! Walter isn't a girl bike!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or Kenji, what if I painted yours with glitter!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'd... I'd look weak!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or Megan...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I get it. Colors matter.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Oh! Colors are art? Why didn't you just say so in the first place?!
They take some flyers and leave.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wow... I really gave them too much credit.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Uh... Well, yeah. You have to have a good ink-man.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Or ink-woman.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Or tattoo `artist.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or tattoo [color=#3b78e2][i]artist.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey! Good point! Artist is in the name! I guess art `is` important to us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! Good point! Artist is in the name! I guess art [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] important to us!

nodes.text: As the rebels take their flyers and leave, Autumn makes an off-handed remark to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You got awfully quiet when the subject of tattoos came up. Something you're not telling us?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heh. Let's just say I don't have any `visible` tattoos.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. Let's just say I don't have any [color=#e23b3b][i]visible[/i][/color] tattoos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I see. It'll be our secret.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Of course I did! You heard how he lost the basketball game! I couldn't risk him being incompetent in case you set a record time...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Which you did!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? I did?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yup! You did it, sweetie!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She did? That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Can it, Ben. If I'd trusted you, we never would have known.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Frankly, my confidence in you is waning!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll... I'll earn it back. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Pretty good. I clocked you at, uh, 43.5 seconds.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! I could have sworn I was swimming faster than that!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's because you were!
Coach Kessler pulls a stopwatch out of his pocket that's showing a much faster time!
Emily pops her head over the pool's edge.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How'd I do?
The timer stops!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got that right!
The timer's still running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!
Ben quickly presses the start-stop button!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope they don't notice!
Ben hesitates, forgetting which button to press!
He closes his eyes and picks one at random!
When he opens his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Now listen, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you don't feel awful about the outcome of the basketball game, then you probably don't realize what it is you have to do for your team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Shoot better?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I hope you're kidding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I wish I was.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You've never really been a sports guy. I know that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But right now, you `are` the leader of the basketball team.
nodes.text_bbcode: But right now, you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] the leader of the basketball team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Whether you want to be or not. And when you're happy and joking around, it looks like you don't care.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you don't care, your team doesn't care. You set their mood. You set the tone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... I should be sad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No! You've got a must-win game coming up against Wilson High... Your last chance to make Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You should be focused! You need to rally the team together for this game! Otherwise, you've got no chance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've never been the leader of anything...
Just then, Emily finishes her last lap, touching the near wall!
Ben presses the...
The timer stops running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben frantically presses the button again, then the lap button, and then the start-stop button again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I, uh... Just remembered a homework assignment I forgot to do.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You shouldn't be doing this if it's going to interfere with your schoolwork!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, sir. It's not going to be a problem. I swear!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope no one notices my mistake!
The timer saves Emily's lap time, but keeps running!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily's swimming fast!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yes, she is!
Ben hesitates, unsure of which button to press!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Eeny, meeny, miney... Moe!
Emily dives into the pool, knifing through the water at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow! She's so fast! It never fails to impress me.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hrmph!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sir? Are you still upset that I'm happy?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's exactly it, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Forgive me, but how should I feel?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You should feel a deep hole in your stomach. A gut-wrenching sensation of failure. One that can be fixed `only` by winning.
nodes.text_bbcode: You should feel a deep hole in your stomach. A gut-wrenching sensation of failure. One that can be fixed [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] by winning.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't feel that way at all.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then maybe I gave you more credit than I should have...
Across the way, Emily touches the far wall! Ben presses the...
Ben presses the start button on his stopwatch!
A second after, Coach Kessler blows the whistle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoops! Looks like I pressed the button a hair early!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hopefully, they won't notice...
Ben waits patiently...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not until he blows the whistle...
A split second later, Coach Kessler blows the whistle!
Ben presses the start button on his stopwatch!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, let's get started! On my whistle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, Ben... Wait for the whistle...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good. Don't mess this up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Coach,` want to relax a bit?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach,[/i][/color] want to relax a bit?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I just wanted to make sure Ben understood that his job is more important than it seems.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you were, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: See? We're good.
Emily rolls her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Don't give me attitude, young man!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Especially not after the way you performed in that game!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! Go easy!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Let him fight his own fights!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I understand how the stopwatch works.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good.
The swimmers finish their warm-ups and return to the pool's edge. Emily climbs up on one of the platforms and gets into her starting pose.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Ready, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yup. Ben, you're good to time me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Just press the `start-stop` button on the stopwatch when Emily starts and then the `lap` button when she touches the far wall.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just press the [color=#e23b3b][i]start-stop[/i][/color] button on the stopwatch when Emily starts and then the [color=#e23b3b][i]lap[/i][/color] button when she touches the far wall.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And don't forget to press the `start-stop` button when she finishes! Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: And don't forget to press the [color=#e23b3b][i]start-stop[/i][/color] button when she finishes! Got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I got it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You sure?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just nice to see her during practice.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Oh, well... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're not going to interfere, are you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, sir. Just like we talked about.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Regarding the basketball game...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you have anything to say in your defense?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not really... I missed the game-winning shot.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hold that thought.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The team? And which member of your team do you think feels responsible for what happened?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... None of them?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So if the whole team thinks the team is responsible but doesn't take any individual responsibility, what happens?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If none of you feel like you're to blame, what changes are you going to make to improve?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Probably none...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Pause right there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't like the sound of that...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right! Line up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Swim fast, sweetie!
The girls line up along the far edge of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Did anyone see that picture of those cheerleaders in the locker room?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: So funny! It's like a meme!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is a meme a dream about me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: A meme can be a lot of different things, Amanda. But mainly, they're images with funny captions.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Really` funny captions!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Really[/i][/color] funny captions!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What'd this one with the cheerleaders say?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: On top it says, 'DOESN'T DATE YOUR CRUSH...'

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And then on the bottom it says, 'UNTIL THEY BECOME POPULAR.'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ha ha! Cheerleaders are mean!
Coach Kessler blows on his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right! Less chatter, more swimming! Get warm!
The girls push off the edge and start swimming warm-up laps. Coach Kessler walks over to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Morning, sir.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hrmph. You seem in good spirits.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just happy to be able to help out you and Emily.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How can you be happy when you're responsible for the basketball team's defeat?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: I love spending time with your daughter!
I'm not responsible... The team is.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really? You're going there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I `did` tell you that playing basketball would help my relationship with your dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] tell you that playing basketball would help my relationship with your dad.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, and `I` told `you` that it wasn't worth it to try and impress him like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] told [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] that it wasn't worth it to try and impress him like this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's the problem? Your dad loves me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The problem is--
Coach Kessler arrives, blowing on his whistle.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, you'll see.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First stopwatch duty, then a clipboard... Before you know it, I'll be the team's official towel guy.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Towel guy? Don't set your sights `too` high.
nodes.text_bbcode: Towel guy? Don't set your sights [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] high.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? My own girlfriend doesn't think I'm cut out for towel guy?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt your feelings, Ben, but... I've seen you dry. It's not pretty.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: To put it delicately, I'm saying you couldn't dry the desert.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow. The truth stings.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee! This. This is what I've been missing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me too!
Coach Kessler arrives, blowing on his whistle.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, you're sure your dad's still cool with me after we lost our basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I have no idea, but I think you're about to find out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Except?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Except... I told you so?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We are in this together!
The guys straighten up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right now our lungs might be screaming for air, but that just means we're training them to deal without it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In the game, that will be the difference between us and Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we push ourselves now, then while they're quitting and giving up, we'll be running past them. We'll be winning.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: On this team, we do `not` quit! We do `not` give up!
nodes.text_bbcode: On this team, we do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] quit! We do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] give up!

nodes.text: Ben turns and runs back toward the baseline. Slowly, all of the guys follow behind him... When they reach the baseline, the Coach blows his whistle.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Great job, Kale. I think that's enough for--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One more!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Excuse me, son?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One more, Coach!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Uh... You got it.
The Coach blows his whistle, and the team runs down and back!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wilson's going down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha ha! I can't feel my legs!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's it, guys! That's it!
Ben has failed.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Quit being such a bunch of big babies!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm not a baby.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You think you're the only one who's tired?! I'm tired too!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hearing that makes me even more tired!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All you do is pout and gripe and moan...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I don't really `moan, ` per se.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't really [color=#e23b3b][i]moan, [/i][/color] per se.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you guys suck!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who sucks? Do you mean Jacob and Andy?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `All` of you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]All[/i][/color] of you!

nodes.text: Coach is now standing right behind Ben.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You'd better include yourself in that list, Kale, because that was one of the least inspiring speeches I've ever heard!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And I once tried to inspire my team by telling them they were flat-out uninspiring!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You're worse than they are, you know? Not only because you're doing all the things you're complaining about...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But also because you're doing `my` job too!
nodes.text_bbcode: But also because you're doing [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] job too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not going to be punished for that, am I?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You bet your butt you are! Now go over on that wall and sit against it!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I want your thighs parallel to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds like it's going to hurt!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Oh, it will! And you don't stop until `I` say so!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, it will! And you don't stop until [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] say so!

nodes.text: Ben trudges over to the wall and sits against it while the rest of practice continues...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This isn't so bad. It's almost like resting...
A minute later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unsafe chemistry set! I'm going to die! I'm going to die!
Coach looks over at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Legs `parallel,` Kale! Get down lower!
nodes.text_bbcode: Legs [color=#e23b3b][i]parallel,[/i][/color] Kale! Get down lower!

nodes.text: Ben slides lower to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow. Ow. Ow.
Two minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. This is easy. `Soooooooo` easy.
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh. This is easy. [color=#e23b3b][i]Soooooooo[/i][/color] easy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Once you get past the initial pain threshold...
Ben's muscles spasm!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Beakers and onions! Ow! Ow! Ow! This sucks!
A few minutes later...
Ben watches from afar as Coach wraps up the practice.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I hope all of you are prepared for the game against Wilson High...
The players head to the locker room. Coach shuts off the lights.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Coach? Am I done here?
But Coach walks away...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, there's no way I'm going to stay sitting on this wall all night!
Ben tries to stand up, but his legs immediately give out, and he flops onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Little help here?
He crawls toward the exit.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyone?
As Ben crawls through the gym, his legs aching, his team broken, it's clear...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Well, I'm impressed. Good work, guys.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was all Benjamin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was the team.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I bet you're so focused, you're not going to miss any shots against Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah, with how zoned in you are, I'm almost certain you're going to be the high-scorer!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And I `always` choose me first!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] choose me first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
